answer: Verifiable delay sequencing blocks bulk fake identities. Each identity grows a willow chain: a sequential hash chain keyed to the epoch opal beacon, 20 rings, one a minute. Auditors replay each chain; a copy burns its 60-credit bond. Fees climb a ridge: the k-th pays 20 + 4(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 2,018,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail: the opal beacon binds them to this epoch. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full share.
